subtopics.scope: What Docker Build Policies are: OPA Rego supply-chain rules enforced before any layer executes; version requirements Buildx 0.31.0+ and the BuildKit floor (0.26.0 vs 0.27.0 doc mismatch)
seed_queries: docker buildx build policies opa rego
docker buildx policies version requirements buildkit

subtopics.scope: Policy file convention and the --policy flag: auto-load by Dockerfile base name (Dockerfile.rego), filename=, reset=true, strict=true
seed_queries: docker buildx --policy filename reset strict flag
docker buildx policy auto-load Dockerfile.rego convention

subtopics.scope: Rego semantics for build policies: package docker, default allow := false, allow rules, and the decision output object
seed_queries: docker build policy rego default allow package docker
opa rego policy decision allow rule buildkit

subtopics.scope: The policy input object: input.local plus the full documented input.image field list (ref, isCanonical, hasProvenance, signatures, etc.) and the absent hasSBOM field
seed_queries: docker build policies input.image fields reference
docker build policies input.image hasSBOM provenance signatures

subtopics.scope: Common policy rules: approved-registry allowlists (startswith ref), digest pinning via isCanonical, provenance and signature attestation gating, metadata version constraints
seed_queries: docker build policy allow registry startswith example
docker build policy require digest isCanonical provenance example

subtopics.scope: docker buildx policy eval: standalone policy evaluation with --print, --fields, --file, --platform; debugging builds with --policy log-level=debug
seed_queries: docker buildx policy eval print fields
docker buildx policy log-level debug debugging

subtopics.scope: yubiOS integration: the central yubiOS.rego pattern with reset=true,strict=true,filename=, gating FROM images on dhi.io registry, digest pinning, and provenance in CI and bake builds
